extraction.notes: The official site has a Summer 2027 program list and says enrollment is open. Its accessible Dates & Rates text does not expose session dates, numeric age bands, or tuition amounts. Direct browser opens returned empty content; additional official pages were readable through search results. A third-party directory lists 2027 dates and rates, but these were not used because they could not be verified on official pages. Mini Camp and Sessions 1 and 2 are grouped as the traditional overnight program; Maker Camp Week is a separate specialized offering. Session rows are empty because verified dates are required for rows.

excluded.name: Family Camp
excluded.reason: Family-only weekend retreat, July 30–August 1, 2027, rather than an independently attended youth camp.

excluded.name: Being a Counselor
excluded.reason: Summer staff employment opportunity, not a youth camp program.

cards.name: Camp Arrowhead for Boys
cards.description: Boys participate in blacksmithing, woodworking, archery, outdoor skills, camping trips, and camp-wide games. Mini Camp introduces younger boys to activities with their cabin groups; longer sessions allow campers to select activities and develop skills.

registration.text: Early Bird Discount- Register by November 1, 2026, to receive $150 off eligible 2027 tuition.

availability.text: Enrollment is open and is filling fast!

transportation.text: If your son is flying to camp, we are happy to pick him up in Asheville, NC (AVL) or Greenville, SC (GSP).

cards.review_notes: Check the visual session table or registration application for 2027 dates, age bands, and tuition for Mini Camp, Session 1, and Session 2's two- and three-week options. The 2027 offerings are announced, but no calendar dates were recoverable from official text; season.status is not_posted to indicate dates were not verified. Transportation wording was available through an official search result.

cards.name: Maker Camp Week
cards.description: Boys work with guest makers and camp staff on blacksmithing, woodworking, leatherwork, bushcraft, and other hands-on projects. The week can be attended independently or added after the three-week session.

availability.text: Enrollment is open and is filling fast!

cards.review_notes: The official Maker Camp Week search result states ages 12 and up for stand-alone attendance; eligibility for younger three-week campers staying for the add-on is not stated. Verify 2027 dates, maximum age, and tuition in the visual Dates & Rates table or registration application. Session 2 three-week campers receive a 50% Maker Camp tuition discount. The $150 early-bird discount applies to eligible tuition, but Maker Camp eligibility is not specified, so no deadline was assigned to this card.
